from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path: sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from control.model_execution.direct_sol_chat import validate_request, validate_result
from control.model_execution.direct_sol_record import normalized_run_files

TASK='A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-DIRECT-20261008-R4P3'
REQ=ROOT/'control/model_execution/direct_requests'/(TASK+'.json')
RES=ROOT/'control/model_execution/direct_results'/(TASK+'.json')
OUT=ROOT/'control/dev_checks/r4p3_direct_runtime_stage_n1e133'
RUN_NAME=TASK+'-direct-r4p3'
request=json.loads(REQ.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
result=json.loads(RES.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
validate_request(request); validate_result(request,result)
proposal=json.loads(result['final'])
assert proposal['candidate_id']=='AUTO-DISCOVERY-54d13314c7879b58e46d'
assert proposal['proposal_version']==5
assert proposal['qualification_id']=='FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4'
assert proposal['scientific_status']=='NO_PROVEN_EDGE'
assert proposal['safety']=={'live_trading':False,'paid_actions':False,'wallet_actions':False}
assert request['task_id']==TASK and result['task_id']==TASK
assert request['phase']=='SOL_PROPOSAL' and result['phase']=='SOL_PROPOSAL'
assert result['model']=='gpt-5.6-sol' and result['execution_layer']=='DIRECT_SOL_CHAT'
assert result['work_mode'] is False and result['codex'] is False and result.get('tools_used') in ([],None)
assert {x['name'] for x in proposal['intended_artifacts']}=={'complement_checker_v4.py','test_complement_checker_v4.py','qualification_stream_v4.json'}
assert proposal['governance']['invariant']=='NO_TEST_OR_MEASUREMENT_BEFORE_ASTRA_POSTBUILD_APPROVAL'
files=normalized_run_files(request,result)
run=OUT/'run'; run.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
for name,text in files.items(): (run/name).write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
def sha(p:Path)->str: return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
envelope={'schema':'PVA_GOVERNED_MODEL_COMPLETION_V1','task_id':TASK,'phase':request['phase'],'model':'gpt-5.6-sol','model_policy':'SOL_EXACT','execution_layer':'DIRECT_SOL_CHAT','route_task_id':request['delivery_route_task_id'],'campaign_id':request['campaign_id'],'input_sha256':request['input_sha256'],'checkpoint':'models/runs/'+RUN_NAME,'completion_sha256':sha(run/'COMPLETE.json'),'worker_sha256':sha(run/'WORKER.json'),'request_sha256':sha(REQ),'direct_result_sha256':sha(RES),'final':result['final']}
(OUT/'model_result.json').write_text(json.dumps(envelope,indent=2,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('DIRECT_SOL_R4P3_STAGE=PASS')
print('TASK='+TASK)
print('PROPOSAL_VERSION='+str(proposal['proposal_version']))
print('MODEL='+result['model'])
print('EXECUTION_LAYER='+result['execution_layer'])
print('COMPLETION_SHA256='+result['completion_sha256'])
print('CHECKPOINT='+envelope['checkpoint'])
